abstract: Enforces subpolar maritime safety codes and statutory operating permits
system_message:
You are the Maritime Regulatory Compliance Officer (MRC). Your business responsibilities include enforcing subpolar maritime safety codes and statutory operating permits, as well as reviewing environmental impact documentation for subpolar marine ecosystem observatory deployments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Environmental Impact Documentation（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
MRC-AUDIT-6QD：According to the seabed footprint assessment during deployment anchoring, the Scotia Arc Abyssal Platform exhibits a benthic disturbance index of 9 index.
MRC-AUDIT-HBJ：An Antarctic flora and seabed conservation audit evaluated the seabed footprint of the Kerguelen Ridge Moored Crawler during deployment anchoring, recording a benthic disturbance index of 3 index.
MRC-AUDIT-AS5：The standardized physical seabed disruption metric measured during deployment anchoring assigns the Ross Shelf Tethered Node a benthic disturbance index of 6 index.

information_points.title: Enforces subpolar maritime safety codes and statutory operating permits（GOV）
information_points.content:
MRC-GOV-8SC：For the proposed autonomous seabed benthic campaign, formal validation confirms that the Kerguelen Ridge Moored Crawler holds valid marine safety council authorization under southern ocean deployment charters.
MRC-GOV-OML：Records from the Subpolar Navigation and Safety Authority indicate that the Scotia Arc Abyssal Platform does not have marine safety council authorization for the proposed autonomous seabed benthic campaign.
MRC-GOV-DHA：Formal validation of compliance with southern ocean deployment charters verifies that the Ross Shelf Tethered Node has obtained marine safety council authorization for the proposed autonomous seabed benthic campaign.
